message.title: Euronext Oslo Børs - BLUENORD ASA - Received application for listing of bonds
message.body:
Euronext Oslo Børs has received an application for ISIN NO0013750828 to be admitted to stock exchange listing.
 
The Market Abuse Regulation (MAR) applies from the time the application has been made, including the issuer's disclosure obligation on inside information.

category.category_en: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
